title: Reshaping temporary accommodation
intro: Young disabled people in North-East London are leading research to improve temporary accommodation.

blocks.heading: Building knowledge and solutions
paragraphs: In partnership with Disability Rights UK and funded by Trust for London, the project works with young disabled people to build knowledge and power, and challenge an unjust housing system.

blocks.heading: Get in touch
paragraphs: For information about the research or working with Toynbee Hall, email research@toynbeehall.org.uk.
